preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The length of each string n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The total length of all strings across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of symbols erased to make the string a palindrome.
If it is impossible to make the string a palindrome, the output must be -1.
